findings.detail: The strict release resolves twenty reviewed NIST AI RMF Playbook evidence references.
The deterministic preview is valid for two knowledge notes and one bilingual governance question; the active vault remains unchanged.
Existing AI literacy and lifecycle-change questions are reused; the proposal adds only the societal-impact feedback topic.
The NIST AI RMF Playbook is voluntary framework guidance and does not establish universal legal obligations.
Approval is required for this exact candidate before integration.
